classification.difficultyReason: Several linked decisions using the demonstrated definitions or procedures. Page 42 defines Z, page 44 excludes -3 and includes 5, and intersection retains only values satisfying both conditions.

content.prompt: Sketch the following on the number line. $(-3,5]\cap\mathbb Z$

answer.worked:
Keep only integers greater than $-3$ and at most $5$:
$$(-3,5]\cap\mathbb Z=\{-2,-1,0,1,2,3,4,5\}.$$
Draw eight isolated filled points; do not join them.
